newsitem.title: UK: Lehman leads $355.053 mln structured 144a issue.
newsitem.headline: Lehman leads $355.053 mln structured 144a issue.

text.p: SASCO 1997-N1LLC has launched a seven-tranche structured 144a issue totalling $355.053 million, lead manager Lehman Brothers said on Monday.
Tranche A2 is for $114.263 million, paying one month libor plus 18 basis points, with an average life of 0.42 years.
Tranche B is of $56.689 million, paying one month libor plus 33 basis points, with an average life of 0.68 years.
Tranche C is for $50.722 million, paying one month libor plus 43 basis points, with an average life of 1.14 years.
Tranche D is for $41.771 million, paying one month libor plus 53 basis points, with an average life of 1.14 years.
The issue and reoffer price is par for these tranches. The legal maturity is September 25, 2028 and the payment date is August 5, 1997 with a short first coupon.
There are also three privatly-placed tranches of $20 million, $44.755 million and $26.853 million.
The issue is unlisted and denominations are 25 thousand. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 7658
